familiar.scope: Measure one 700-tic sprite/model pair for a real Familiar/Ao Ao; no campaign or crowd budget.

ao_ao.scope: Measure one 700-tic sprite/model pair for a real Familiar/Ao Ao; no campaign or crowd budget.

iterations: Initial source omitted required UV rectangles for reused iris/dark materials; generation stopped before output.

First exported zero-radius sweep tips lacked tip_pole flags, leaving collapsed triangles and invalid closed topology. Explicit pole fans corrected all claws/tails/horns before native review. The initial geometry report also preceded the native include.

First native review exposed eye bulges, a contrasting mastiff muzzle and high ram horns. Refinements recessed then brought forward the irises, darkened the mastiff muzzle, differentiated ram muzzle/hooves, lowered horn coils and reduced wool locks.

Explicit2x2 wool UV repeats split seams without editing pixels. Neutral-compatible idle phase/offset changes produce distinct native idle samples. Final nose taper and wider head/lying cameras preceded all final package tests.
qualifications: Thirty-six inspected captures cover eight directions/detail views and ten action samples per model. Native state/pixel checks cover all23 frames; this is not ordinary gameplay or author acceptance.

Simplified rounded anatomy, broad/faceted noses and horns, repeated matte fur/wool, simple joint rotations and rigid falling/rest poses remain candidates. Conceptual metre sizes and species behavior were not introduced. Horizontal silhouettes and lying poses extend beyond unchanged collision.

One sequential700-tic sprite/model pair per species measures queue intervals, not GPU/display latency, repeatability or campaign/crowd budget. Projected footprints differ. No siege performance improvement is inferred.
Twenty-one of56 provisional new catalogue classes now have direct native models;35 remain. Named characters, modular style/fitting and unauthored V5.16 progression remain open.
No executable, DLL, IWAD, compiled test package or save is committed. Private preview.pk3 is included only in repeat hashes.
